spec.hypothesis: Parser fix + prompt enhancement + speed optimization (collapse_detection off) enables GRPO learning signal with <50% invalid_action
spec.description: Phase A fixed: parser adapts Qwen3 format + prompt enhancement + collapse_detection off + 30 steps + 64 traj/step + 30 max_turns
spec.dryrun_conclusion: Parser fix effective (95.3%→6.5% invalid). Speed 12min/step (vs 95min). action_is_valid low (5.4%) but expected for untrained base model. Approved for 30-step training.
